scope: Planning inputs for the worked branch in BRANCH-COMPLETE.md. Fictional. Offline allocations; no production configuration and no execution.

parents.note: Appendix C allocates London 10.10.0.0/19 (including 10.10.16.0/20 reserved for London growth), Manchester 10.10.32.0/20 and Reading 10.10.48.0/20, and leaves 10.10.64.0/18 and 10.10.128.0/17 unallocated. A new branch comes from the unallocated pool, not from another site's reservation. IPv6 /56 blocks follow the same scheme: London 00, Manchester 01, Reading 02, so this branch takes 03.

spare.note: Genuinely unassigned. A site with no spare subnet is a site whose next requirement is a renumbering.
